whatIs: Recent is an inspiration gallery that mixes many kinds of design work: web interfaces, branding, motion, illustration, posters, print, launch videos, websites, OG images, app screenshots and icons. Each piece is credited to its author and has its own page.
It's a good fit when you want to browse a variety of references and filter them by category, rather than look for a specific interface pattern.
uses: Looking at other products' OG images before designing the ones for your site.
Browsing app icons for inspiration for your own app's icon.
Watching product launch videos to plan yours.
caveats: You browse by categories and filters (Web Interface, Branding, Motion…); there's no search to find a specific piece.
The feed includes sponsored placements mixed in with the pieces.
It mixes different disciplines, so you have to go into the right category to avoid seeing posters when you're looking for interfaces.
pricingNote: You can browse without paying; the site shows sponsorships and job listings.
idealFor: Anyone looking for varied visual inspiration organized by type of piece.
